decisions.reason: The firm has invested heavily in a multi-model LHD loader line that is central to its underground mining focus and has announced it publicly, and one year is too early to blame any weak results on anything but temporary ramp-up causes, so management stays committed.

The underground dump truck line was launched alongside the loaders as part of the same publicly announced mining strategy, and the sunk development costs, its complementarity with the loaders, and the long sales cycles typical of mining equipment favour keeping it.
